notes: renderer=software; unthrottled_redraw=true; frame_ms = interval between consecutive about_to_wait calls that follow a winit RedrawRequested (i.e. after Slint render + softbuffer/GL present returned, measured from the winit CustomApplicationHandler); redraw requested continuously from about_to_wait (bypasses Slint's 60Hz Timer frame throttle when unthrottled=true); first 2s warm-up not recorded. 3 screens as Rectangles whose x has animate 300ms ease-in-out; modal opacity animate 200ms; sequence cycle push,push,modal-open,modal-close,pop,pop at one step per 300ms; transitions_done counts steps whose animation window elapsed; one background thread burns a core
